hints.title: Tree Structure
hints.text: The graph is a tree with n nodes and n - 1 directed edges.

hints.title: Root Zero Baseline
hints.text: Run a first depth-first search from node 0. Count edge reversals needed to reach all nodes from root 0.

hints.title: Rerooting Step
hints.text: When transitioning root from u to v along edge (u, v): if edge was directed u->v, cost increases by 1; if v->u, cost decreases by 1.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Two linear tree traversals using rerooting technique.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running a fresh traversal from every node takes O(n^2), which times out for n = 100,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) adjacency lists and answer vector.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply tree rerooting dynamic programming to achieve linear time.
